scenario: Binary scalar min(a,b) / max(a,b) per LEXP.3.8 — pairwise min/max over two numeric operands, distinct from the series aggregations min(s,w)/max(s,w) (the overload resolves by arg type). The winning operand's Int/Float kind is preserved; the clamp idiom max(min(x,hi),lo) composes.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r_max:
    T t where max(t.v, 3) == 5
->
    log critical "max"

rule r_min:
    T t where min(t.v, 3) == 3
->
    log critical "min"

rule r_clamp:
    T t where max(min(t.v, 10), 1) == 5
->
    log critical "clamp"

rule r_float:
    T t where max(t.v, 7.5) == 7.5
->
    log critical "float"
